selection_rationale: Monotonically decreases from 6.20% to 1.60%; crosses 5.0% mission budget at 1px (4.20%).
Upper CI bound crosses 5.0% mission budget only at 3px (4.21%) and 5px (3.20%); at 2px upper bound is 5.17%.
Perfect retention (34.80%) preserved at 0px, 1px, and 2px due to r <= 2.5 px central aperture shield; drops at 3px and 5px.
Extended recovery constant at 17.40% through 2px; profile wings clipped by aggressive dilation at 3px and 5px.
Peaks at 3px (0.8126), virtually indistinguishable from 2px (0.8122); declines slightly at 5px (0.8118).
Mask area cost accelerates above 2px (5.42% at 3px, 9.15% at 5px). 2px uses only 3.79% of cutout pixels.
Strict 0.00% encroachment maintained at 0px, 1px, and 2px; unshielded encroaching masks emerge at 3px and 5px.
Zero genuine anomalies lost up to 2px. Dilation >= 3px causes genuine candidates to be suppressed.
